instruction: I went on a vacation trip to amsterdam with my roommates. Share all of its photographs with them over email. You should send one email with everyone as recipients. Photographs can be found in my file system, and they should be attached as a zip file.
notes: Three apps plus supervisor: phone to discover roommates' emails (search_contacts with relationship filter), file_system to locate the Amsterdam photo directory and compress it to a single .zip (delete_directory left at default false so no files are updated/removed; only the zip is added), gmail to send ONE email with all roommates as recipients and the zip attached via attachment_file_paths + file_system_access_token. Static init facts (recipients-for, photos-of, zip-of, username-for) tie runtime-discovered values to the lookup that produces them; knowledge predicates (known-recipients, directory-found, zip-created) gate downstream actions. supervisor-complete-task takes the email-list and zip file as non-API record parameters so its precondition equals the goal; it is the only action that asserts (task-completed) and all other actions require (not (task-completed)). No answer is passed since the task asks for an action, not a question.
